jd:
Introduction

We power the backend of a cloud-based sales enablement platform used by IBM’s global sales force to market and sell IBM Power Systems hardware, software, storage, and services. Our team ensures seamless product configuration, accurate pricing, and flawless manufacturing fulfillment by maintaining and enhancing several mission-critical applications. We’re looking for a passionate Software Engineer to help us build robust, scalable systems that directly impact IBM’s business success.

Your Role And Responsibilities



- Design, develop, and optimize backend logic that drives marketing and product configuration rules across sales and manufacturing systems.
- Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve complex issues spanning multiple integrated applications and services.
- Analyze and process intricate product data sets to ensure alignment with IBM’s engineering and marketing standards.
- Translate detailed specification documents of infrastructure into clean, efficient code and data models supporting sales and manufacturing configurator.
- Enhance and maintain DevOps automation tools primarily written in CML, Java/Python, and other modern technologies.

Preferred Education

Bachelor's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise



- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
- Proficiency in Python/ Java, with a strong foundation in backend application development.
- Proven ability to handle complex, detail-oriented tasks with precision and accountability.
- Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams.
- Strong analytical mindset with demonstrated problem-solving capabilities.
- Ability to manage priorities, deliver high-quality results under deadlines, and continuously improve existing processes.
fit_why: Backend Python/Java config systems; fits stack, enterprise domain unfamiliar

Acumatica is a company on a mission. We are a leading innovator in cloud ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) solutions with growing businesses worldwide. But don’t take our word for it—read what analysts like G2, IDC, Nucleus Research, and Info-Tech have to say about us. Acumatica is different by design and purposely built to help small and midsized companies thrive in today’s digital economy. Our industry-specific business management solution is engineered to address real-world needs—featuring intelligent workflows and market-leading usability that enable companies to manage risk, anticipate disruption, and seize new opportunities. Our principled business practices, growth-friendly licensing, and flexible deployment options put organizations in control of their own future. Acumatica is more than just a product—we are a community of partners, customers, and creators committed to elevating business performance. Our ecosystem is driven by collaboration, merging leading technology and real-world insights to put organizations control of their future. In May of 2025, Acumatica was acquired by Vista Equity Partners, a global investment firm focused on enterprise software, data and technology-enabled businesses. 


Acumatica’s culture is collaborative and high-energy. We are passionate about our product and our mission, and we are loyal to each other and our company. We value work/life balance, efficiency, simplicity, freakishly friendly customer service, and making a difference in the world. Acumatica offers exceptional professional and financial growth potential. To learn more about Acumatica’s mission, please visit: http://www.acumatica.com

Job Description


As an Intern Developer, you will be part of Acumatica team of developers that collaborate and create large-scale, production-grade cloud-based ERP, CRM, and other web applications using Microsoft technologies (.NET, C#, MS Sql Server) for businesses around the world. We are looking to hire an Intern Developer for the Summer internship (4-month contract, 40 hours a week) to work with our team in the Montreal office. 


Responsibilities:



- Help the team, participating in the design and development of business applications and customizations. 
- Develop of the data access layers, business objects, and presentation layers. 
- Research and prototyping ERP modules using new technologies. 
- Support for existing code, code optimization and refactoring. 
- Analyze the code, search for and correct errors in the existing functionality. 
- Provide guidance and support to developers in Acumatica’s development network. 
Développeur/Développeuse


En tant que stagiaire développeur , vous ferez partie d'équipe de développeurs d'Acumatica qui collaborent et créent des applications de grande échelle, de production, cloud-based ERP, CRM et autres applications web à l'aide des technologies Microsoft (.NET, C#, MS SQL Server) pour les entreprises à travers le monde. Nous sommes à la recherche d'un stagiaire développeur pour l'internship d'hiver (contrat de 4 mois, 40 heures par semaine) pour travailler avec notre équipe dans le bureau de Montréal.


Compétences et responsabilités :



-   Aidez l'équipe en participant au design et au développement d'applications d'affaires et de personnalisations. 
-   Développement des couches d'accès aux données, des objets métier et des couches de présentation. 
-   Recherche et prototypage de modules ERP à l'aide de nouvelles technologies. 
-   Support pour le code existant, optimisation et refactoring du code. 
-   Analyse du code, recherche et correction d'erreurs dans la fonctionnalité existante. 
-   Fournir des conseils et un soutien aux développeurs du réseau de développement Acumatica. 

Qualifications



- You are studying and you are enrolled in the Co-op program, and you have accumulated the specific number of course credits and you are eligible to register for the Engineering internship program or Science internship program (depending on the University where you are studying). 
- You have knowledge of C# and experience in writing complex queries. 
- Knowledge of version control systems (preferably Git). 
- You have strong knowledge of the principles, patterns, and design of complex software systems, and the ability to apply them in practice. 
- You’re passionate about writing things that are “elegant and efficient” – things that are robust, scalable, and that perform well. 
- Your personal software practices ensure you deliver high quality even under pressure. 
- You enjoy collaborating with, learning from, and teaching others (including across disciplines) so we all become better. 
Qualifications



-   Vous êtes étudiant et vous êtes inscrit(e) au programme Co-op, et vous avez accumulé le nombre spécifique de crédits universitaires et vous êtes éligible à vous inscrire au programme d'internship en ingénierie ou en sciences (selon l'université où vous étudiez). 
-   Vous avez des connaissances en C# et une expérience dans l'écriture de requêtes complexes. 
-   Connaissances des systèmes de contrôle de version (préférablement Git). 
-   Fortes connaissances des principes, modèles et conception de systèmes logiciels complexes, et la capacité d'appliquer ceux-ci en pratique. 
-   Vous êtes passionné(e) par l'écriture de choses qui sont « élégantes et efficaces » – choses qui sont robustes, scalables et qui fonctionnent bien. 
-   Vos pratiques personnelles logicielles vous assurent que vous livrez une qualité élevée même sous pression. 
-   Vous appréciez la collaboration avec, l'apprentissage de, et l'enseignement aux autres (y compris à travers les disciplines) afin que nous devenions tous meilleurs. 

Additional Information


Acumatica is an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.




If you have a disability and you believe you need a reasonable accommodation in order to search for a job opening or to submit an online application, please e-mail HR@acumatica.com. This email is created exclusively to assist disabled job seekers whose disability prevents them from being able to apply online. Only emails sent for this purpose will be returned. Emails sent for other purposes, such as following up on an application or technical issues not related to a disability, will not receive a response. 


Benefits and perks may vary based on the nature of your employment. Eligible employees have access to competitive compensation and RRSP matching, paid vacation, personal and sick days, comprehensive health and dental benefits, health and personal spending accounts, an Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and office perks including weekly team lunches, daily snacks and refreshments, and a modern downtown Montreal workplace.




At Acumatica, certain roles are eligible for additional rewards, including annual bonus and stock. These awards are allocated based on individual performance. In addition, certain roles also have the opportunity to earn sales incentives based on revenue or utilization, depending on the terms of the plan and the employee’s role.


Acumatica est un employeur pratiquant l’action positive et offrant l’égalité des chances en matière d’emploi aux anciens combattants et aux personnes en situation de handicap. Toutes les candidatures qualifiées seront prises en considération pour un emploi, sans égard à la race, à la couleur, à la religion, au sexe, à l’orientation sexuelle, à l’identité de genre, à l’origine nationale ou au statut d’ancien combattant protégé. Aucune discrimination fondée sur le handicap ne sera exercée.nnSi vous êtes une personne en situation de handicap et que vous croyez avoir besoin de mesures d’adaptation raisonnables pour consulter une offre d’emploi ou soumettre une candidature en ligne, veuillez envoyer un courriel à HR@acumatica.com. Cette adresse courriel est exclusivement destinée à aider les personnes en situation de handicap dont le handicap les empêche de postuler en ligne. Seuls les courriels envoyés à cette fin recevront une réponse. Les courriels envoyés pour d’autres raisons, notamment pour faire un suivi concernant une candidature ou pour signaler des problèmes techniques qui ne sont pas liés à un handicap, ne recevront pas de réponse.n


Les avantages sociaux et les autres avantages peuvent varier selon la nature de votre emploi. Les employés admissibles ont accès à une rémunération concurrentielle et à un régime de cotisation de l’employeur au REER, à des vacances, à des journées personnelles et à des congés de maladie payés, à une assurance maladie et dentaire complète, à des comptes de dépenses de santé et personnelles, à un programme d’aide aux employés (PAE), ainsi qu’à des avantages au bureau, notamment des dîners d’équipe hebdomadaires, des collations et des rafraîchissements quotidiens, et un milieu de travail moderne au centre-ville de Montréal.


Chez Acumatica, certains postes donnent droit à des récompenses supplémentaires, notamment une prime annuelle et des actions. Ces récompenses sont attribuées en fonction du rendement individuel. De plus, certains postes offrent également la possibilité de recevoir des incitatifs à la vente fondés sur les revenus ou l’utilisation, selon les modalités du régime et le rôle de l’employé.

role: Technical Learning Content Development Intern, Physical AI — Summer 2027
jd:
Today, NVIDIA is tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in an inclusive, encouraging environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how we can make a lasting impact on the world.

 Join NVIDIA’s Physical AI Technical Marketing team to help developers learn how to build AI systems that perceive and interact with the physical world. Work with engineers and educators to turn robotics and simulation workflows into tested labs, tutorials, and learning experiences. You’ll own a scoped project from a working example through learner testing and publication, helping developers and partners put NVIDIA technology into practice.

 What you’ll be doing: 
 
• Collaborate with technical marketing, product, engineering, and training teams to design learning content for a selected robotics, simulation, or AI workflow accurately 
• Build developer-friendly hands-on learning content with clear prerequisites, exercises, expected results, and troubleshooting guidance. 
• Test tutorials and lab environments from a new learner’s perspective; reproduce failures and work with engineers to resolve them. 
• Create reusable diagrams, short demonstrations, and knowledge checks that connect technical concepts to practical tasks. 
• Maintain learning materials in version control, incorporate learner feedback, and document updates so the content stays usable as software changes. 
 What we need to see: 
 
• Pursuing a BS or MS in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent program area. 
• Python programming demonstrated through coursework, a research project, or a software project. 
• Coursework or project experience in at least one of robotics, machine learning, computer graphics, or simulation. 
• Experience using Git and a Linux development environment to run, debug, and document software. 
• A technical writing or teaching sample, such as a tutorial, project README, lab guide, or recorded demonstration that explains a working project. 
• Demonstrated experience leveraging open models and agentic tools to produce production-ready content and materials. 
 Ways to stand out from the crowd: 
 
• A project using one or more of NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, Cosmos, Jetson, Omniverse libraries, OpenUSD, or ROS (Robot Operating System). 
• Experience turning a robotics, synthetic-data, or simulation project into a reproducible example others can run. 
• Teaching, tutoring, workshop, or open-source contribution experience, with examples of improvements made from user feedback. 
• Passion for creating technical diagrams, videos, or accessible learning materials. 
• Using AI tools with a documented process for checking their output. 
 NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you!

Our internship hourly rates are a standard pay based on the position, your location, year in school, degree, and experience. The expected hourly rate for this position is 20 USD – 71 USD. 
 You will also be eligible for Intern   benefits . ​ 

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 9, 2026. 
 This posting is for an existing vacancy. 
 NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.
 
NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.
fit_why: Learning-content role on robotics/simulation; strong Python, weak on Isaac/ROS
